name: DomainIndex
description: Domain appraisals, price estimates, search metrics, keyword parsing, WHOIS and availability through DomainIndex's documented JSON API. Self-service paid subscriptions provide API access; free Starter does not. Supports batches of up to 1,000 domains and returns USD estimates. Quotas and data freshness depend on the provider. Documentation: https://domainindex.com/api.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Register at https://domainindex.com/ and choose a paid API-enabled plan at https://domainindex.com/subscriptions. Copy the key from Account → My API (https://domainindex.com/account/my-api). Starter has no API access.
